title: What If You Woke Up 1,000 Years in the Future?
description:
It's the year 3026. You can't read the signs, nobody understands a word you say, and your own germs might make you a walking outbreak. Here's the real science of waking up 1,000 years in the future: how you'd actually get there, what's changed, what survived, and why your money is worthless.

Would YOU go? Tell me in the comments 👇

▶ Watch first: What If You Were Frozen for 100 Years? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5D-s1nQuhWk

CHAPTERS
0:00 Waking up in the year 3026
0:20 How you'd get there (cryonics or time dilation)
1:36 Nobody understands you
2:34 A walking outbreak
3:19 Do future humans look different?
4:07 Earth in 1,000 years
4:56 The same sky (and Voyager 1)
5:37 What survives
6:41 Is your money worth anything?
7:29 You're history

SOURCES
• Nishiyama Onsen Keiunkan, Japan: oldest hotel, founded 705 AD
• Time dilation at 99.99% of light speed (special relativity, Lorentz factor ≈ 70.7)
• Old English Lord's Prayer: "Fæder ūre þū þe eart on heofonum"
• Earth's day lengthens ~1.7 ms per century (tidal friction)
• Voyager 1 (NASA/JPL), launched 1977
• Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena, oldest operating bank, founded 1472
